meta.name: add-dial-number
meta.description: Add another phone number to an existing Dial channel — a second (or third) public line for the agent, so one NanoClaw install answers SMS and AI voice calls on multiple numbers. Use when Dial is already installed and the operator wants an additional number (e.g. a personal line plus a support line). Requires the Dial channel to already be installed (see /add-dial).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让同一安装接听多个号码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要给现有直线添加额外接听号码
copy.tagline_en: Answer calls on multiple numbers from a single installation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a Dial channel and need to add another number

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可为已装好的 Dial 频道再添一个（或几个）电话号码；每个新号独立成一条公开线程，对方发到哪个号，回复就从哪个号发出。
howto.when: 当 Dial 频道已经装好，你想给它再添一个电话号码（例如个人线之外再加客服线）时；前提是 Dial 已安装，否则先运行 /add-dial。

say.text: 给 Dial 加一个新号码 +14155550123
say.note: Claude 会校验号码并开始配置新线路。

say.text: 再给 Dial 加一条公开电话线
say.note: Claude 会列出当前号码，让你选择要添加哪个。

say.text: 给新增的 Dial 号码设置入站访问为 strict
say.note: 该线路将只允许已知用户联系。

howto.what_en: Adds another phone number to an installed Dial channel: each new number is a separate public threaded line, and the agent replies from whichever number received the message.
howto.when_en: Use when Dial is already installed and the operator wants an additional public line (e.g., a support line beside a personal one). Requires the Dial channel to be set up first; run /add-dial if not.

say_en.text: Add the Dial number +14155550123 for me
say_en.note: Claude validates the number and starts setup.

say_en.text: I want to add a second public Dial line
say_en.note: Claude lists current numbers and asks which to add.

say_en.text: For the new Dial number, set inbound access to strict
say_en.note: Only known users can text this line.
